latest_release.name: 🍂🐮 Moovember 2026 | Feature & Security Update: Mailbox Groups, imapsync Rework & SOGo 5.12.13 - Revision B
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
### Security
* [PHP] Update to 8.2.36, fixes several PHP security issues (e34905807, #7671). The critical CVEs don't affect a default mailcow installation, but we recommend updating anyway.

### Translations
* Translations update from Weblate by @milkmaker in https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/pull/7674


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mailcow/mailcow-dockerized/compare/2026-11a...2026-11b
